key_insight: GGPO replaces high-variance learner-to-behavior importance weighting with a KL-adjusted log-mean-exp objective over grouped responses, while retaining a principled link to KL-regularized optimality.
engineering_relevance: It is a practical off-policy RL recipe for training language models from stale or mismatched offline data, especially when long responses make importance weighting unstable.
method: Optimize a log-mean-exp contrast of KL-adjusted rewards across responses to the same prompt.
Derive the objective from KL-regularized policy optimization, so the on-policy population loss matches the KL-regularized optimality gap.
Use reference-policy refresh to control policy staleness and preserve reward guarantees under finite data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that with fixed reference GGPO scores 32.96 on a five-benchmark problem-weighted average, while the default refresh schedule reaches 46.58, and that GGPO outperforms GRPO and AGRO under mismatch and fixed offline data.
watch_item: Performance depends on reference refresh and coverage assumptions, so stale references or weak data support can materially degrade results.
paper_title: Gibbs-Gap Policy Optimization for Off-Policy RL with Verifiable Rewards
